column4: All eight displayed companion-animal topic cards reviewed; the only oncology topic links to observational feline mammary tumour research. Add ENVT as an official source for future therapeutic discovery.
Feline mammary tumour incidence in relation to prior spay timing; no study-assigned anticancer intervention.
Official Québec hospital research overview, contains no specific clinical-study invitation or oncology-protocol link in its main body. Do not count as a recruiting roster.
Official Hebrew University unit overview describes research capacity and collaborations. No owner recruiting cancer protocol links in actual program body.
Official permitted unit child describes babesiosis, parvovirus and other research topics. No current study-specific invitation in body; exact separate master remains unavailable.
Official NUS research outcome for already treated dogs using engineered MSC/5-FC. Article describes observed results and development, no current intake.

UF assigns a bone-stabilizing cement procedure and related follow-up to dogs already scheduled for SBRT. Research objective is fracture risk/pain; coverage applies to cementoplasty and selected follow-up, not the tumour-directed radiation itself. Distinct from VOS anticancer ECT and Oniris cement study.

Current sponsor explicitly closed recruitment for the same four-dose post-splenectomy splenic HSA chemotherapy; all eight sponsor clinics examined, including both BluePearl branches. Canonical already inactive.
Four Paccal Vet doses, stage I/II splenic HSA post-splenectomy, Kirkland and Tacoma; exact sponsor study, not a new recruiting protocol.
MT-003 + radiation for canine nasal cancer; exact detail accessible but absent from current center list. No current confirmation of open slots across the linked official pages.
Enzistat treatment lead for dogs with two advanced cancer cohorts. Official current study indexes omit it; older opening story cannot by itself establish current owner intake.
Same Cornell B-cell protocol assigning personalized pretreatment before CHOP, Ithaca, $1000 support and 10% hospital discount. This was already cataloged.
Mars sponsor VCA Dallas protocol, HIFU plus doxorubicin and Dallas veterinary oncologist. No BluePearl HSA equivalence.
OSU Bracha localized canine STS anti-MIC plus NK, same intervention and $700 completion payment. December 2025 inside PDF is a document date, not enrollment cutoff.

ICCI points to separately retrieved active OVC clinical lists; its COTC rapamycin and recombinant Listeria HER2 projects are explicitly closed and outcomes published. Current OVC oral SCC porphysome is separate.

VetAgro Sup hospital sibling listing includes osteoarthritis, GI and periodontal/senior dog trials. No additional therapeutic oncology protocol in that body; separate CICV oral malignant tumour study is independently known.
Yamaguchi publication matches company-run canine oral melanoma anti-dog PD-1 at Tokorozawa, Yamaguchi and Kyoto, exact existing three-site cohort. No new site added.
Actual Indonesian university publication describes in vitro XPO1/verdinexor testing of eight canine lymphoma cell lines; no patient protocol.
Chilean research CRO site describes contracted trial design and operations. No sponsor protocol link for a current client-owned dog/cat cancer treatment.
Actual archived protocol describes toceranib for confirmed macroscopic feline mammary disease. No dated current intake, current local contact or cost terms established.
Distinct named canine COX2 cohort. Protocol would supply study drug, but current dated enrolment/site never established by undated category or leaf.
Exact historical AB07008 protocol text for canine cutaneous MCT corroborated; no dated current availability of this cohort at VOC.
Current sponsor primary states recruitment completed for feline Paccal Vet dose escalation in spontaneous solid tumours; separate protocol from canine splenic HSA.

Distinct Hungarian trial of postoperative autologous tumour vaccine for dogs, first 20 eligible, named Budapest university and hematology/oncology sites. Exact organizer page explicitly states submissions are temporarily paused. This is neither PT001 nor a current referral pathway.

Sponsor's exchange disclosure says Hungarian regulator granted permission for PT001 canine oral melanoma field study on 2026-09-11. Exact Taiwanese protocol taiwan-protect-pt001-oral-melanoma has eight Taiwan sites; no matching Hungarian cohort intake notice or exact site listed. Permission is not recruitment. Primary Hungarian protocol and local contact/cost missing.
